paper.title: Reducing Dueling Bandits to Cardinal Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Utility-Based Dueling Bandits (UBDB), finite X, linear link
unmapped: regret measured on the unobserved average utility (u_t+v_t)/2 of the two played arms
settings.definition_quote: The linear link function $\philin$ is defined by $$\Pr[b_t = 1 | (u_t,v_t)] = \philin(u_t, v_t) \eqdef  \frac{ 1+v_t - u_t} 2$$ The \emph{unobserved} reward is $\Umeant = (u_t+v_t)/2$, and the corresponding regret after $T$ steps is $\Rmean(T)  \eqdef\sum_{t=1}^T(\mu(x^*) - \Umeant)$

settings.name_in_paper: UBDB over a general (possibly infinite, structured) X with linear link, using an SBM black box
unmapped: generic arm set X; guarantee is relative to the regret of a black-box MAB algorithm (SBM)
settings.definition_quote: Consider a  UBDB game over a set $X$.

settings.name_in_paper: UBDB with linear expected utility over a compact convex set X in R^d
settings.definition_quote: In this setting, the set $X$ of arms is an arbitrary (infinite) convex set in $\R^d$. Here, the player chooses at each time point a vector $x \in X$ and observes a stochastic reward with an expected value of $\dotprod{\mu}{x}$

settings.name_in_paper: UBDB, linear utility over a polytope, Delta-gap case
settings.definition_quote: In case  $X$ is a polytope with vertex set $V$ and there is a unique vertex $v^*\in V$ achieving $\max_{x\in X} \dotprod{\mu}{x}$, and any other vertex $v\in V$ satisfies the gap condition $\dotprod{\mu}{v} \leq \dotprod{\mu}{v^*} - \Delta$ for some $\Delta>0$, we say we are in the $\Delta$-gap case.

settings.name_in_paper: Dueling bandits with general preference probabilities satisfying the Relaxed Extended Stochastic Triangle Inequality
unmapped: duel outcome probabilities 0.5+Delta(x,y) satisfying a relaxed extended stochastic triangle inequality with parameter gamma
settings.definition_quote: (Relaxed) Extended Stochastic Triangle Inequality. For some $\gamma \geq 1$, and any pair $x,y$ (where it does not necessarily hold that $x \succ y$) it holds that $\gamma\Delta(x^*,y) \leq \Delta(x^*,x)+\Delta(x,y)$.

algorithms.name: UCB with parameter alpha (exploration (alpha+2) ln t / 2t_x)

bound.regime: SBM has expected regret c log^alpha T for all T

symbols.c_SBM: constant in the SBM's expected regret bound c log^alpha T
symbols.alpha_SBM: exponent of log T in the SBM's expected regret bound

conditions: the SBM black box has expected regret at most c log^alpha T after T steps for all T

source.label: thm:infinite
source.quote: Consider a  UBDB game over a set $X$. Assume the SBM $S$ in Line~\ref{line:SBM} of $\Doubler$ (Algorithm~\ref{alg:infinite}) has an expected regret of $c \log^\alpha T$ after $T$ steps, for all $T$.  Then the expected regret of $\Doubler$ is at most $2c\frac{\alpha}{\alpha+1}\log^{\alpha+1} T$.

results.notes: Reduction result relative to black-box regret. Regret is through means, recorded as pseudo-regret.

bound.regime: SBM regret bounded by f(T)=Omega(T^alpha), alpha>0

symbols.f_SBM: bound on the expected regret of the SBM black box, f(T)=Omega(T^alpha) with alpha>0

conditions: SBM expected regret bounded by f(T)=Omega(T^alpha) with alpha>0

source.label: thm:infinite
source.quote: If the expected regret of the SBM is bounded by some function $f(T)=\Omega(T^\alpha)$ (with $\alpha>0$),  then the expected regret of $\Doubler$ is at most $O(f(T))$.

source.label: cor:finite
source.quote: Assume that the SBM $S$ in Line~\ref{line:SBM} of $\Doubler$ is algorithm \confballtwo (resp.\ \confballone). If $X$ is a compact convex set, then the expected regret of $\Doubler$ is at most $O(\sqrt{dT\log^3(T)})$ (resp.\ $O(\sqrt{d^2T\log^3(T)})$).

results.notes: The corollary pairs ConfidenceBall_2 with sqrt(dT log^3 T), which is the reverse of the pairing in Lemma 2.3 (likely a typo); recorded as stated.

source.label: cor:finite
source.quote: If $X$ is a compact convex set, then the expected regret of $\Doubler$ is at most $O(\sqrt{dT\log^3(T)})$ (resp.\ $O(\sqrt{d^2T\log^3(T)})$).

results.notes: 'resp.' branch; pairing of algorithms is swapped relative to Lemma 2.3.

conditions: Delta-gap case: X a polytope with unique optimal vertex and vertex gap Delta

source.label: cor:finite
source.quote: In the $\Delta$-gap setting (see discussion leading to Lemma~\ref{lem:confball gap}), the expected regret is bounded by $O\left( \Delta^{-1}d^2 \log^4(T) \right)$ (resp.\ $O\left( \Delta^{-1}d^3 \log^4(T) \right)$).

results.notes: Pairing with ConfidenceBall_2 as stated in the corollary (Lemma 2.4 gives d^2 for ConfidenceBall_1).

conditions: Delta-gap case: X a polytope with unique optimal vertex and vertex gap Delta

source.label: cor:finite
source.quote: In the $\Delta$-gap setting ..., the expected regret is bounded by $O\left( \Delta^{-1}d^2 \log^4(T) \right)$ (resp.\ $O\left( \Delta^{-1}d^3 \log^4(T) \right)$).

source.label: cor:infinite
source.quote: Consider a  UBDB game over a finite set $X$ of cardinality $K$. Let $\Delta_i$ be the difference between the reward of the best arm and the $i$'th best arm. Assume  the SBM $S$ in Line~\ref{line:SBM} of $\Doubler$ is  UCB. Then the expected regret of $\Doubler$  is at most $O(H \log^2(T))$ where $H \eqdef \sum_{i=2}^K \Delta_i^{-1}$

bound.expression_latex: O\!\left(\! H \alpha\ln T + H\alpha\left(\!K\ln K\!+\!K\ln\ln T -\!\!\sum\nolimits_{x \neq x^*} \!\ln \Delta_x\!\right) \!\!\right)

symbols.alpha_rob: robustness parameter of the SBM policy, alpha = max(3, ln(K)/ln ln(T))

tuning: SBMs are alpha-robust with alpha = max(3, ln(K)/ln ln(T)), e.g. UCB (Algorithm 1) with parameter alpha

source.label: thm:alg2bound
source.quote: The total expected regret of $\MultiSbm$ (Algorithm~\ref{alg:K TBMs}) in the UBDB game is $O\!\left(\! H \alpha\ln T + H\alpha\left(\!K\ln K\!+\!K\ln\ln T -\!\!\sum\nolimits_{x \neq x^*} \!\ln \Delta_x\!\right) \!\!\right)$, assuming the policy of the SBMs defined in Line~\ref{line:SBMsInit} is $\alpha$-robust for $\alpha=\max(3, \ln(K)/\ln\ln(T))$. The robustness can be ensured by choosing the UCB policy (Algorithm~\ref{alg:ucb}) for the SBM with parameter $\alpha$.

results.notes: H = sum over suboptimal arms of 1/Delta_x. Horizon marked known because alpha depends on T.

symbols.gamma_tri: parameter of the Relaxed Extended Stochastic Triangle Inequality
symbols.alpha_rob: robustness parameter, alpha = max(3, ln(K)/ln ln(T))

conditions: preference probabilities satisfy the Relaxed Extended Stochastic Triangle Inequality with parameter gamma
tuning: MAB policy alpha-robust with alpha = max(3, ln(K)/ln ln(T))

source.label: thm:alg2bound_extended
source.quote: Assume the probability for the outcome of a duel is defined according to $\Delta(x,y)$, where $\Delta$ has the Relaxed Extended Stochastic Triangle Inequality with parameter $\gamma$. The total expected regret of $\MultiSbm$ in the UBDB game is asymptotic to $$\gamma H\alpha \left(K\ln(K)+K\ln\ln(T) +\sum_{x \in X\setminus\{x^*\}} \ln(1/\Delta_x)\right)  + \ln(T)  H \alpha$$ assuming the invoked MAB policy is $\alpha$-robust for $\alpha=\max(3, \ln(K)/\ln\ln(T))$.

results.notes: 'Asymptotic to' read as an order bound; the proof is deferred to a full version. The meaning of Delta_x under the general preference model is not fully specified.
